🔄 Change History

v1.0.5 (Latest)
  • Add callbackURL to Credit Card Payment (Non-UI) field
v1.0.4
  • Added an example response when a payment is completed without going through 3DS payment authentication in Direct 3DS Payment (UI)
v1.0.3
  • Added a new payment method. 3DS payments for VAN22(PCINS HR) must be made using Direct 3DS Payment.
v1.0.2
  • Add returnURL to External UI payment field
v1.0.1
  • Add callbackURL to External UI payment field
  • Change the terminology from ErrorCode to ResultCode
  • Add Result Code: 200 (Request Connection)
v1.0.0
  • Added new payment method. 3DS payments for VAN36 and VAN37 must use External UI Payment. (All future 3D Secure payments are processed via this payment method.)
  • payEmail, payTel fields changed from Optional (O) to Mandatory (M) for Credit Card, Credit Certification, and QR Payment.
  • Add Error Codes: 101, 611, 612, 900, 901, 935, 936, 941

📐 Data Format Principles

  1. Currency Amounts:
    • JPY amounts do not permit decimal points.
    • USD, EUR, CNY amounts allow up to two decimal places (e.g., 19.99).
  2. Card Expiration Date:
    • expireM (Month): Format MM (2 digits). Numbers under 10 must have a leading zero (01, 02, ..., 12).
    • expireY (Year): Format YY (2 digits). Numbers under 10 must have a leading zero (25, 26).
  3. Identifier Fields:
    • payId: Only letters and numbers (a-zA-Z0-9) are permitted.
    • transTime: Format YYYYMMDDHHMMSS (14 numeric digits).

🔍 Detailed Error Cause Breakdown

Code 200

  • Request Connection
  • Mail sent successfully

Code 901

  • VAN login failed (VAN login information is incorrect)
  • Invalid response data (VAN response data is empty or invalid)

Code 902

  • The set currency and payment currency are different, so please check the merchant settings. (The VAN line supports only one payment currency.)

Code 916

  • Required not input (merchantID) (Merchant ID not entered)
  • Required not input (merchantPW) (Merchant PW not entered)
  • Required not input (age)
  • Required not input (tradeGubun) (tradeGubun not entered)
  • Required not input (ref) (ref not entered)
  • Required not input (currType) (currType not entered)
  • Required not input (cardType) (cardType not entered)
  • Card are not supported for payment.
  • Required not input (cardNo) (cardNo not entered)
  • Required not input (expireM, expireY) (expireM or expireY not entered)
  • Required not input (payName) (payName not entered)
  • Required not input (payId) (payId not entered)
  • Required not input (payTel) (payTel not entered)
  • Required not input (productName) (productName not entered)
  • Required not input (price) (price not entered)
  • Required not input (transNo) (transNo not entered)
  • Required not input (regularId) (regularId not entered)
  • The email format is invalid.
  • Please contact the Merchant.

Code 936

  • Minimum payment amount must be ? Yen or more. (The minimum payment amount (Yen) set for the entire account or by store has not been met.)
  • Minimum payment amount must be ? Dollar or more. (The minimum payment amount (Dollar) set for the entire account or by store has not been met.)

Code 941

  • This payment has already been refunded. (There is already a canceled transaction.)
  • This payment is being refunded. (There is already a transaction waiting to be canceled.)

UI Payment

Hosted payment screen workflows via browser redirect / form POST.

Credit Card Payment & Credit Certification (UI)

Redirects the customer's browser from the general merchant order screen to the PCINS Hosted Payment screen for Credit Card Payment (tradeGubun=1) or Credit Certification (tradeGubun=7).

Note: Since this is a browser redirect Hosted Payment, the transaction results are returned via returnURL (Query String) and callbackURL (Async Notification) upon completion. If 3D Secure authentication is triggered, an XML response is returned.

📌 Transaction Types (tradeGubun)

  • tradeGubun=1: Credit Card Payment (Standard online credit card payment)
  • tradeGubun=7: Credit Certification (Card verification without charging amount, price=0)

🔄 Interaction Flow

  1. Step 1 (Request Start): Merchant submits HTML Form POST to /pay_link.jsp with Master fields (No 1 ~ No 12).
  2. Step 2 (Enter Info): Customer enters credit card details on PCINS secure hosted payment page.
  3. Step 3 (Return Result): PCINS redirects back to merchant's returnURL and notifies callbackURL (POST method).

📩 Return Parameters

  • Success Callback (callbackURL):
    callbackURL?merchantId={id}&ref={ref}&payId={payId}&currType={cur}&price={price}&transNo={transNo}&transCode=AS
  • Success Return (returnURL):
    returnURL?transCode=AS&transNo={transNo}&ref={ref}
  • Failure Return (returnURL):
    returnURL?transCode=AF&transNo={transNo}&ref={ref}&errCode={errCode}

External UI Payment (3DS)

External hosted payment page supporting 3D Secure authentication. Required payment method for VAN36 and VAN37.

Note: All future 3D Secure payments will be routed via this method.

🔄 Interaction Flow

  1. Merchant POSTs payment request to /pay_external.jsp.
  2. Gateway responds with JavaScript redirect script (window.location.href).
  3. Customer completes 3DS challenge on external bank authentication page.
  4. Results are reported to callbackURL and customer is redirected to returnURL.

📩 Return Parameters

  • Success Callback (callbackURL):
    callbackURL?merchantId={id}&ref={ref}&payId={payId}&currType={cur}&price={price}&transNo={transNo}&transCode=AS
  • Success Return (returnURL):
    returnURL?transCode=AS&transNo={transNo}&ref={ref}
  • Failure Return (returnURL):
    returnURL?transCode=AF&transNo={transNo}&ref={ref}&errCode={errCode}

Direct 3DS Payment (UI)

Direct 3D Secure authentication payment for VAN22 (PCINS HR). Allows merchant checkout page to collect card and address information directly and submit to PCINS for 3DS verification.

🔄 Interaction Flow

  1. Merchant collects card details + billing address (cityCode, address, postCode).
  2. Merchant POSTs data to /pay_direct3ds.jsp.
  3. If 3DS challenge is required, customer is redirected via Javascript (<script>window.location.href=...</script>).
  4. If transaction succeeds without 3DS friction, <tranactionresponse> XML is returned immediately.

📩 Return Parameters

  • Success Callback (callbackURL):
    callbackURL?merchantId={id}&ref={ref}&payId={payId}&currType={cur}&price={price}&transNo={transNo}&transCode=AS
  • Success Return (returnURL):
    returnURL?transCode=AS&transNo={transNo}&ref={ref}
  • Failure Return (returnURL):
    returnURL?transCode=AF&transNo={transNo}&ref={ref}&errCode={errCode}

QR Payment (UI)

Redirects customer from general merchant order screen to the Alipay / WeChat Pay QR Payment interface.

Note: Since this is a browser redirect Hosted Payment, the transaction results are returned via returnURL (Query String) and callbackURL (Async Notification) upon payment completion.

🔄 Interaction Flow

  1. Merchant submits HTML Form POST to /qr_link.jsp with currType=CNY (or JPY).
  2. Customer scans QR code with Alipay/WeChat app and authorizes payment.
  3. Gateway triggers callbackURL and redirects customer to returnURL.

Non-UI Payment

Direct Server-to-Server API operations including payments, refunds, speed payments, and inquiries.

Credit Card Payment, Refund, Speed Payment & Inquiry (Non-UI)

Direct Server-to-Server API for processing transactions without a hosted payment screen.

📌 Supported Operations via tradeGubun

  • tradeGubun=1: Credit Card Sale / Speed Payment (Direct card authorization)
  • tradeGubun=2: Credit Card Refund (Cancel/refund approved payment)
  • tradeGubun=9: Transaction Inquiry (Query transaction status by ref)

⚡ Speed Payment (Non-UI)

When using stored user card information, set cardNo to one of the following virtual search codes:

  • 88888888888888: Search by merchantId + payTel + payId
  • 88888888888881: Search by merchantId + payTel
  • 88888888888882: Search by merchantId + payId

Webhooks

Asynchronous payment result callbacks and 3DS notifications.

Payment Result Notification (3DS Webhook)

Used by the merchant to notify PCINS of the 3D Secure completion or query final authorization state after challenge completion.

🔄 Interaction Flow

  1. Customer completes 3DS verification with the card issuer.
  2. Notification is dispatched with transNo and checkoutId.
  3. PCINS confirms transaction and returns final <TransactionResponse>.
